commands.method: quick install script (Debian/Ubuntu and RHEL/Fedora, stable)
apt (Debian/Ubuntu): update and install after adding repo
commands.command: sudo apt update && sudo apt install teams-for-linux

note: The project's own site gives a quick install script and repo-based apt/yum installs; the manual repo-file steps were only partly captured, and Flatpak/Snap have no commands on the page.
